notes: Old reliable and an OG. What I'd describe as an "average good" energy drink - closest to their Fruit punch flavor.
body:
One of my first alani flavors. I think I'll continue to see it often. In terms of all energy drinks that I would drink willingly and I'd consider good, this is their median. It pretty much just tastes like fruit punch + some coconut with a bit of sour to cut through.

Overall taste: (Obviously) very tropical. Most similar to a mix of strawberry + pineapple + coconut + some slightly tart berry closest to blackberry. Honestly just think about the last time you had fruit punch, and this is it, with probably a slight sour taste that cuts through nicely as you sip.

Overall: Solid. It's a punch. What I like about it is that it's very minimally mouth drying. Leaves you slightly dry and fades away in time for the next sip. That does mean its chuggability is low here, but a nice few hour sip drink with a good but common taste.
name: Hawaiian Shaved Ice
